Class ReportCurrencyMapLoader

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reports.ReportCurrencyMapLoader
@Component public class ReportCurrencyMapLoader extends Object
Loads the exchange rates a tenant report converts with. The dividends report and the realized gain report share it, so both read the same rates for the cash account currencies of the transactions of a tenant.

Important: This class is a stateless Spring component and holds no member variables besides its repositories.

    • loadForCashaccountAndSecurityCurrencies

      public DateTransactionCurrencypairMap loadForCashaccountAndSecurityCurrencies(Tenant tenant, LocalDate untilDate)
      Loads the rates of every currency the transactions of the tenant are exposed to, the currency of the cash account and the one of the security, on the day of each transaction and whatever its type. The finance costs of a margin product need such a rate as well, and a sale of a security in a third currency needs the rate of its currency.
      Parameters:
      tenant - the tenant whose transactions determine the rates
      untilDate - the last day the report covers, normally today
      Returns:
      the currency map until the given day
